label: Google Hotel Ads (hotel campaigns via Hotel Center)
terms_note: Hotel Center account (partner or hotel) + Google Ads; Hotel Prices API (transaction messages / XML) and Hotel Content (Lodging Format) feeds; free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 / Hotel Center account (Hotel Prices + Hotel Content APIs); campaigns via the Google Ads API

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** as its own row — price / content feeds via the Hotel APIs; campaigns through the Google Ads API (google client) Confidence: **high**.
auth: 1. Hotel Center account linked to Google Ads.
2. Send price / content feeds (Hotel Prices API, Lodging Format).
3. Manage hotel campaigns with the google client (campaign type HOTEL, bidding percent CPC / commission).

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: https://developers.google.com/hotels offers only Hotel Prices (price feeds, API/XML reference), Hotel Content (Google Lodging Format), Vacation Rentals and connectivity partners. Hotel campaigns, budgets and reports are managed through the Google Ads API (the `google` entry); no campaign, budget or ad-report call exists in the Hotel APIs to map to this vocabulary.
